title.en: Add public Help audio course room
title.zh: 新增公开音频 Help 课程室

purpose.en: Give signed-in members one administrator-hosted Help room with private support chat and optional host audio.
purpose.zh: 为登录会员提供一个由管理员主持的 Help 房间，支持私密服务聊天及按需主持音频。

en: Show Help immediately before Sign out in the account menu.
Show the room as an ordinary public course tile without a description.
Require sign-in to enter; retain v2 Gold private chat, attachments and audio lifecycle.
zh: 在账户菜单退出登录前显示 Help。
将房间作为普通公开课程卡片显示，不显示介绍。
进入时须先登录，沿用 v2 Gold 私聊、附件及音频生命周期。

en: GreatLoveMeta account menu, public course directory, Help route and course entry.
zh: GreatLoveMeta 账户菜单、公开课程目录、Help 路由及课程入口。

en: Reuse the reviewed GlobalCitizen Help-room SQL, route and tests with GreatLoveMeta locale and class adapters.
Use full-document navigation for anonymous Help tile entry to preserve mobile Safari login redirect.
Create one free public audio Webinar in site-owned D1; it does not start media on page view.
zh: 复用已验证的 GlobalCitizen Help 房间 SQL、路由及测试，仅适配 GreatLoveMeta 语言和课程结构。
公开 Help 卡片使用整页导航，确保移动 Safari 登录跳转正常。
在本站 D1 创建一个免费公开音频 Webinar；浏览页面不会启动媒体。

en: Run Help contract, protected-navigation check, all repository tests, zero-warning lint, build, fresh migrations and exact deployment verification.
zh: 运行 Help 契约、受保护导航检查、全量仓库测试、零警告 lint、构建、空白迁移和精确部署核验。

en: Live multi-user media test is outside this Help-navigation-only rollout.
zh: 本次仅迁移 Help 导航，不重复多用户实时媒体测试。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, locale routes, payments and site-owned Cloudflare resources.
zh: 保留 GreatLoveMeta 品牌、语言路由、支付及本站 Cloudflare 资源。

rollback.en: Revert application while retaining the additive Help room record until safely retired.
rollback.zh: 可回退应用，新增 Help 房间记录保留至安全下线。

productionVerification.en: Verify matching GitHub main commit, successful Cloudflare workflow, public Help tile, sign-in redirect and Project release record.
productionVerification.zh: 核对 GitHub main 提交、Cloudflare 工作流、公开 Help 卡片、登录跳转及 Project 发布记录。
